name: @sos-2/greenfield-runtime
description: SOS 2.0 Greenfield Runtime (Work Order P13): the §11 flagship journey engine — a typed state machine driving 'user mission -> connect GitHub repo -> formalize mission -> architecture/capability plan -> candidate + assurance -> worker task graph -> summon cloud body -> implementation -> independent evaluation -> repair/retry or ASK -> commit/PR/push -> deployment -> runtime verification -> evidence-backed completion report' over the MERGED surfaces, composed never re-implemented: the P6 @sos-2/task-graph is THE durable graph (mission + authority refs pinned, typed transitions, disjoint scopes); body selection/assignment through the P5 BodyBroker contracts (capability-based, cloud placement — the journey continues while the user's computer is off, driven purely by cloud tick sources); body-side work through the P8 HarnessContract seam; repository realization through @sos-2/project-realization (P9 gateway only); completion gated ONLY by the independent P9 evaluation suite (evaluator + evaluation-orchestration RepairLoop discipline: bounded repair attempts, then typed ASK; the pipeline NEVER certifies its own output — a completion request from the acting body is a typed independence violation); the GitHub connection through the P4 GitHubPort adapter surface (honest SIMULATED reference states); every stage transition emits a P7-discipline observation event into the durable P2 store (the replayable timeline a disconnected user returns to). The completion report carries exact source revisions, evaluation results with retained uncertainty, remaining uncertainty and a reproducible content-addressed completion record. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers/child_process in src — clocks, stores, seams and tick sources are injected; the composition root (tests/mission-to-repo) is the impure boundary.
